name: uams-web/uamswp-team-to-people-migrator
description: One-time migration tool that copies Team Showcase entries into People Showcase on the same site. Development dependencies only: nothing is installed into production.

scripts.mutate: pest tests/Unit/AdminMenuTest.php tests/Unit/AdminPageTest.php tests/Unit/HelpersTest.php tests/Unit/LocationsTest.php tests/Unit/MigratePostTest.php tests/Unit/MigrationTest.php tests/Unit/ShortcodeTest.php --mutate --path=uamswp-team-to-people-migrator.php

scripts-descriptions.test:unit: Run the Pest suite that needs no WordPress and no database.
scripts-descriptions.mutate: Run mutation testing over the plugin file (the chain passes --path to narrow it). Every test file is named: the bootstrap loads Patchwork, and an unnamed run scans tests/Unit and scores every mutant killed without running it. Add a new test file here.
scripts-descriptions.stan: Run PHPStan at the level phpstan.neon.dist sets.
scripts-descriptions.refactor:sweep: Apply Rector's sweep profile (review the diff).
